creator: A travel creator with 1.2M followers
headline: 6 brands are waiting for your answer

lead.why: Monsoon Audio needs an answer by Thursday, and they offered less than your rate.

deals.subject: Paid collab: new Monsoon Buds launch
deals.fit: Earbuds for long bus rides. It fits your travel gear videos.
watch: They want to run your reel as an ad for 6 months. That is usage rights, and it usually costs extra.
If you don't answer by Thursday, they will ask the next creator.
deals.reply:
Hi Neha,

Thanks for thinking of me for the Monsoon Buds launch. I'd love to do it.

For 1 reel and 3 stories my rate is [₹1,50,000]. That covers posting on my page. If you want to run the reel as an ad for 6 months, the usage rights are [₹40,000] extra.

I can post by [18 October]. Can you send me the brief and the contract?

Thanks,
[Your name]
deals.replyHinglish:
Hi Neha,

Monsoon Buds launch ke liye mujhe yaad karne ke liye thank you! Ye collab karne mein mujhe khushi hogi.

1 reel aur 3 stories ka mera rate [₹1,50,000] hai, mere page par posting ke liye. Agar reel ko 6 mahine ad ki tarah chalana hai, toh usage rights [₹40,000] extra honge.

Post [18 October] tak ho jayega. Brief aur contract bhej dijiye?

Thanks,
[Your name]

deals.subject: YouTube integration for our travel eSIM
deals.ask: A 60-second part in your next YouTube video
deals.fit: Your viewers ask about phone SIMs in almost every country video.
watch: They pay 60 days after the video goes live. Ask for half before you shoot.
deals.reply:
Hi Arjun,

Thanks for reaching out. My viewers ask me about SIM cards all the time, so Roamly fits my channel well.

For a 60-second part in a YouTube video my rate is [₹3,00,000]. I work with [50%] paid before the shoot and the rest when the video goes live.

If that works for you, I can put it in my [Israel] video. Can we talk this week?

Thanks,
[Your name]
deals.replyHinglish:
Hi Arjun,

Reach out karne ke liye thanks. Mere viewers mujhse SIM cards ke baare mein hamesha poochte hain, toh Roamly mere channel ke liye perfect hai.

YouTube video mein 60 seconds ka mera rate [₹3,00,000] hai. Payment [50%] shoot se pehle aur baaki video live hone par.

Agar ye theek hai, toh ise mere [Israel] video mein daal sakte hain. Is hafte baat karein?

Thanks,
[Your name]

deals.subject: Brand ambassador for our trail shoes?
deals.ask: Ambassador for 3 months: 2 reels a month
deals.fit: Walking shoes. You film a lot of walking tours.
watch: No other shoe brand for 6 months, but they only pay for 3.
deals.reply:
Hi Priya,

Thank you, I'd love to work with Nomad Soles. I walk a lot on my trips, so it's a natural fit.

The fee of ₹3,00,000 for 3 months works for me. One thing: the contract asks for 6 months with no other shoe brand. Can we make that [3 months], the same as the deal?

Thanks,
[Your name]
deals.replyHinglish:
Hi Priya,

Thank you! Nomad Soles ke saath kaam karne mein mujhe khushi hogi. Meri trips mein walking bahut hoti hai, toh ye natural fit hai.

3 mahine ke liye ₹3,00,000 theek hai. Ek baat: contract mein 6 mahine tak koi aur shoe brand nahi. Kya ise [3 mahine] kar sakte hain, deal jitna hi?

Thanks,
[Your name]

scams.subject: Sign your contract today
scams.why: The 'contract' is a file that runs a program (contract.pdf.exe).
